subject.title: fix: strip JSON5 trailing commas from YAML frontmatter before parsing (#108432)

question: Should this contribution be salvaged through a clean replacement branch, or closed and resubmitted because the current head removes protected repository infrastructure?
rationale: The protected security surface and the product choice between strict diagnostics and accepting non-YAML syntax require explicit owner intent; automated repair should not normalize this branch silently.

options.title: Require a clean replacement
options.body: Ask for a branch from current main containing only the parser, focused tests, and real skill-discovery proof, with all `.github` and dependency files untouched.

options.title: Keep strict YAML
options.body: Reject JSON5 compatibility and instead add a visible diagnostic naming the malformed SKILL.md file and parse failure.

options.title: Close and invite resubmission
options.body: Treat the destructive branch state as non-salvageable and invite a fresh narrowly scoped PR after security review.

recommendation.title: Require a clean replacement
recommendation.body: Ask for a branch from current main containing only the parser, focused tests, and real skill-discovery proof, with all `.github` and dependency files untouched.

likelyOwner.reason: The history most directly connects this person to the security ownership and guard files removed by the branch.
